# 04 Cover

Full definition: [TAXONOMY.md](../../TAXONOMY.md), section 3.

**What belongs here.** A third layer (neither A nor B) covers the frame, hides the change, then uncovers B.

**Test.** Pause at the middle: is the frame mostly or entirely a layer that is neither A nor B?

**Not here.** A cover made of light is 09 Light. A flat colour faded by opacity is 02 Blend › Dip to Colour. A shape that reveals B inside itself with no cover phase is 03 Wipe › Shape Mask.

**Build.** Bridged structure: cover → hold → reveal. One shape engine draws the cover, then draws it inverted so B shows through holes. Reference: Organic/Liquid Fill.

## Subfamilies

| Folder | What goes in it | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| [Organic](organic/) | The cover is a fluid, natural or noise-driven substance. | liquid fill, ink bleed, paint splat, smoke, reaction-diffusion |
| [Geometric](geometric/) | The cover is built from clean shapes. | shape burst, grid of circles or squares, hexagon fill |
| [Stroke](stroke/) | Drawn strokes sweep across and fill the frame. | brush stroke, marker swipe, ribbon |
| [Panel](panel/) | Solid slabs slide or unfold across, then off. | curtain, sliding colour bars, stacked panels |
| [Stinger](stinger/) | A branded or character graphic covers the cut. | logo stinger, mascot run-across |

## Transitions in this family

| Transition | Subfamily | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [Ink Bleed](organic/ink-bleed/) | Organic | Drops of ink land and spread with fibrous edges until the frame is solid, then the next scene bleeds back through. |
| [Liquid Fill](organic/liquid-fill/) | Organic | Blobs of liquid grow into cells with thin veins, the veins pinch away until the frame is one colour, then the next scene floods back in the same way. |
| [Paint Drip](organic/paint-drip/) | Organic | Paint pours down from the top in uneven drips that join into a solid frame, then drains away to show the next scene. |
| [Shape Burst](geometric/shape-burst/) | Geometric | Rings of colour burst out from a point one after another until the last one covers the frame, then a hole bursts open the same way. |
| [Shape Grid](geometric/shape-grid/) | Geometric | A grid of shapes scales up in a wave until they cover the frame, then shrinks away in the same direction to show the next scene. |
| [Brush Stroke](stroke/brush-stroke/) | Stroke | A thick, rough brush paints across the frame in a few passes until it is covered, then the stroke wipes away to show the next scene. |
| [Swoosh Lines](stroke/swoosh-lines/) | Stroke | Waves of rounded diagonal ribbons sweep across, the last wave in the new background colour, then sweep on out to show the new scene. |
| [Panel Slide](panel/panel-slide/) | Panel | Solid bars slide in one after another to cover the frame, then carry on out the other side to show the next scene. |
| [Logo Stinger](stinger/stinger/) | Stinger | A badge pops in, spins and grows to fill the frame with a word on it, then shrinks back and pops away to show the next scene. |
